edit.description: export the -z --name-only decode the engine already owns
commitsPast reads --name-only through that decode; record separator off NUL

summary: commitsPast decodes --name-only with the engine's shared -z reader instead of line-splitting quotePath output

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: planSliceWindows narrows and judges paths as git committed them; the decode has one home in src/git.ts.
tests: the derive window is live when a commit touches a spec path whose name carries a control character
notes: src/git.ts:161 rules core.quotePath=false non-viable for every --name-only reader; harness/windows.ts:845 is the one reader still taking it, so touches() drops a commit the window should carry. RECORD_SEP is %x00 and collides with -z's own terminators — %x1e is the replacement. nameOnlyPaths is module-private; windows.ts already imports literalPathspecEnv from the same module.
